svg.title: Buccal mucosa graft harvest
svg.desc: The cheek graft is outlined below the parotid duct papilla and away from the oral commissure. The papilla near the upper second molar is a landmark to identify and protect. Check duct position, oral capacity and graft requirements before harvesting. View: Intraoral cheek view. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: EAU Urethral Strictures: disease management in males (2026 web guideline), https://uroweb.org/guidelines/urethral-strictures/chapter/disease-management-in-males; access: official full text; Indications and reconstructive principles; not a validation of every drawn tissue plane. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.

svg.text: Buccal mucosa graft harvest — the workhorse urethroplasty graft
intraoral view of the cheek: harvest centrally, clear of Stensen’s duct and the oral commissure
opposite the 2nd upper molar — stay below
